## benthic-habitat-2007__README.md
# Benthic Habitats of the Main Hawaiian Islands (NOAA NCCOS, 2007)

Shallow-water benthic habitats of the eight main Hawaiian Islands, mapped by NOAA NCCOS from 2007 satellite imagery: 8,762 polygons classed by geomorphological structure, biological cover and reef zone. The layer includes the islands' land as polygons (zone `Land`); exclude it, and zone `Unknown`, for seafloor statistics.

## Files

| Asset | URL |
|---|---|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/benthic-habitat-2007.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/benthic-habitat-2007.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex (resolution 10, parents 9, 8, 0, partitioned by h0) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/benthic-habitat-2007/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

## Columns

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `_cng_fid` | Unique row id, one per polygon |
| `objectid` | Feature id in the state service |
| `uniqueid` | Code for the polygon's structure and cover combination |
| `polygonid` | NOAA quality-control number (not unique) |
| `acres` | Polygon area in acres |
| `m_struct`, `d_struct` | Major and detailed geomorphological structure |
| `m_cover`, `p_cover`, `cover` | Dominant biological cover, its percent, and the two combined |
| `zone` | Geomorphological zone (Reef Flat, Fore Reef, Bank/Shelf, Land, …) |
| `h10`, `h9`, `h8`, `h0` | H3 cells (hex asset only) |

On the hex asset each polygon's attributes repeat on every cell, so deduplicate by `_cng_fid` before summing `acres`.

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
SELECT zone, m_cover, SUM(acres) AS acres
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/benthic-habitat-2007.parquet')
WHERE zone NOT IN ('Land', 'Unknown')
GROUP BY zone, m_cover ORDER BY acres DESC;
```

## MapLibre GL JS

The PMTiles `source-layer` is **`benthic-habitat-2007`**.

```js
import { Protocol } from "pmtiles";
maplibregl.addProtocol("pmtiles", new Protocol().tile);

map.addSource("hi-benthic", {
  type: "vector",
  url: "pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/benthic-habitat-2007.pmtiles",
});
map.addLayer({
  id: "hi-benthic-coral", type: "fill", source: "hi-benthic",
  "source-layer": "benthic-habitat-2007",
  filter: ["==", ["get", "m_cover"], "Coral"],
  paint: { "fill-color": "#ff7f50", "fill-opacity": 0.6 },
});
```

## Provenance and licence

Source: NOAA National Centers for Coastal Ocean Science, 2007 (https://products.coastalscience.noaa.gov/collections/benthic/e97hawaii/data2007.aspx); merged statewide and served by the Hawaiʻi Statewide GIS Program (https://geodata.hawaii.gov/arcgis/rest/services/CoastalMarine/MapServer/1; metadata https://files.hawaii.gov/dbedt/op/gis/data/benthic_habitat.pdf). Retrieved 2026-11-02. The service response is kept unmodified at `s3://public-hawaii/raw/benthic-habitat-2007/benthic-habitat-2007-service-response.geojson` (80,134,352 bytes, sha256 `ff37f44c77853be1a1abec33264118072e33e57a560b49ce4aac131568436dee`).

Licence: public domain (NOAA work; State of Hawaiʻi, https://portal.ehawaii.gov/page/terms-of-use/). No warranty of accuracy.


## coral-reefs__README.md
# Coral Reefs from NOAA Nautical Charts (Main Hawaiian Islands)

Coral reefs in the marine waters around the main Hawaiian Islands, digitized by the Hawaii Statewide GIS Program from the NOAA raster nautical charts of 2002. 474 reef polygons, about 33,355 acres.

These are chart features mapped for navigation, not a habitat survey. They are not to be used for navigation. Coverage is the main Hawaiian Islands only.

## Files

| Asset | URL |
|---|---|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/coral-reefs.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/coral-reefs.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex (resolution 10, parents 9, 8, 0, partitioned by h0) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/coral-reefs/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

## Columns

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `_cng_fid` | Unique row id, one per reef polygon |
| `objectid` | Feature id in the state service |
| `acres` | Reef polygon area in acres |
| `chart1`, `chart2` | NOAA chart number and panel the reef was digitized from |
| `notes` | Chart annotation (e.g. Submerged Reef, Coral Reef Awash) |
| `sourcethm` | Island shapefile before the statewide merge |
| `h10`, `h9`, `h8`, `h0` | H3 cells (hex asset only) |

On the hex asset each polygon's attributes repeat on every cell, so deduplicate by `_cng_fid` before summing `acres`.

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
SELECT sourcethm, COUNT(*) AS reefs, SUM(acres) AS acres
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/coral-reefs.parquet')
GROUP BY sourcethm ORDER BY acres DESC;
```

The PMTiles `source-layer` is **`coral-reefs`**.

maplibregl.addProtocol("pmtiles", new Protocol().tile);

});
map.addLayer({
  id: "hi-coral-reefs-fill", type: "fill", source: "hi-coral-reefs",
  "source-layer": "coral-reefs",
  paint: { "fill-color": "#ff7f50", "fill-opacity": 0.6 },

Source: NOAA Raster Nautical Charts, 2002; Hawaii Statewide GIS Program (https://geoportal.hawaii.gov/datasets/9229d814438349948c99b5e61a084418_7/about; metadata https://files.hawaii.gov/dbedt/op/gis/data/coralreefs_nc.pdf). Retrieved 2026-10-14 from https://geodata.hawaii.gov/arcgis/rest/services/CoastalMarine/MapServer/7. The service response is kept unmodified at `s3://public-hawaii/raw/coral-reefs-service-response.geojson` (2,527,148 bytes, sha256 `d42b995ce1c37dab2a06f6a7e1cbec624132b9ad728bc737db96ae02823dca9c`).

## crcp-reef-fish-surveys__README.md
# NCRMP Reef Fish Surveys, Hawaiian Islands (NOAA PIFSC, 2013–2024)

NOAA PIFSC / NCRMP reef fish surveys across the main and Northwestern Hawaiian Islands, 2013–2024: 2,043 survey site visits and 172,246 fish count records with sizes, taxonomy, trophic group, length–weight parameters, and per-replicate benthic cover and relief.

STAC collection: https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-reef-fish-surveys/stac-collection.json

## Files

| file | contents |
|---|---|
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-reef-fish-surveys/observations.parquet` | every fish count row (non-spatial) |
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-reef-fish-surveys.parquet` | survey site visits, one point each (GeoParquet) |
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-reef-fish-surveys.pmtiles` | survey site visits as vector tiles |
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-reef-fish-surveys/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` | survey site visits indexed to H3 resolution 8 |

## Web map (MapLibre GL JS)

The PMTiles `source-layer` is **`crcp-reef-fish-surveys`**.

```js
map.addSource('crcp-reef-fish-surveys', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-reef-fish-surveys.pmtiles'
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'crcp-reef-fish-surveys', type: 'circle', source: 'crcp-reef-fish-surveys', 'source-layer': 'crcp-reef-fish-surveys',
  paint: { 'circle-radius': 4, 'circle-color': '#1f78b4' }
});
```

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
-- Herbivore biomass (g) per site visit on Oahu
SELECT v.SITEVISITID, v.SITE, v.OBS_YEAR,
       SUM(o.COUNT * o.LW_A * pow(o.SIZE_ * o.LENGTH_CONVERSION_FACTOR, o.LW_B)) AS herbivore_g
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-reef-fish-surveys/observations.parquet') o
JOIN read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-reef-fish-surveys.parquet') v USING (SITEVISITID)
WHERE v.ISLAND = 'Oahu' AND o.TROPHIC_MONREP = 'PRIMARY' AND o.LW_A > 0
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY herbivore_g DESC;
```

US Government work (NOAA), public domain: https://www.noaa.gov/information-technology/public-domain. NCEI states no access or use constraints.


## crcp-subsurface-temp__README.md
# NOAA Subsurface Temperature Loggers, Hawaiian Islands (2005–2024)

In-water temperature from NOAA National Coral Reef Monitoring Program subsurface temperature
recorders at coral reef monitoring sites in the Main and Northwestern Hawaiian Islands: 145 logger
sites (0.3–38.6 m deep) and 88.8 million readings, mostly every 5 minutes, from
March 2005 to August 2024. Public domain (NOAA).

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `crcp-subsurface-temp.parquet` | GeoParquet, one point per logger site |
| `crcp-subsurface-temp.pmtiles` | Vector tiles of the same points (source-layer `crcp-subsurface-temp`) |
| `crcp-subsurface-temp/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` | H3 resolution 8 index of the points |
| `crcp-subsurface-temp/observations.parquet` | Every reading |
| `crcp-subsurface-temp/deployments.parquet` | One row per logger deployment |

Upstream spells each region two ways (`MHI` / `Main Hawaiian Islands`, `NWHI` /
`Northwestern Hawaiian Islands`). The site layer uses the long form; normalise the other tables
before grouping by region. Repeated rows upstream (about a third) were dropped; see the STAC
collection for details and provenance.

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SELECT date_trunc('month', time) AS month, avg(TEMP_C) AS mean_c
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-subsurface-temp/observations.parquet')
WHERE OCC_SITEID = 'OCC-OAH-001'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
```

## MapLibre GL JS

```js
map.addSource('crcp-subsurface-temp', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crcp-subsurface-temp.pmtiles'
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'crcp-subsurface-temp',
  type: 'circle',
  source: 'crcp-subsurface-temp',
  'source-layer': 'crcp-subsurface-temp',
  paint: { 'circle-radius': 4, 'circle-color': '#0b6e99' }
});
```

Source: NOAA Coral Reef Conservation Program, via NCEI ERDDAP
[`CRCP_Subsurface_Temp_Hawaii`](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/erddap/tabledap/CRCP_Subsurface_Temp_Hawaii.html), accessed 2026-11-02.


## crimp2-mooring__README.md
# CRIMP-2 CO2 Mooring, Kāneʻohe Bay (2008–2024)

Surface ocean and atmosphere CO2, sea surface temperature and salinity from the CRIMP-2 MAPCO2 buoy in Kāneʻohe Bay, Oʻahu, 2008–2024, with pH, chlorophyll, turbidity and dissolved oxygen from 2020. 45,277 records from 20 deployments. -999 in the upstream files is stored as missing; quality flags are kept (2=good, 3=questionable, 4=bad, 5=not reported).

STAC collection: https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crimp2-mooring/stac-collection.json

## Files

| file | contents |
|---|---|
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crimp2-mooring/observations.parquet` | every record, all deployments (non-spatial) |
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crimp2-mooring.parquet` | one point per deployment (GeoParquet) |
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crimp2-mooring.pmtiles` | deployments as vector tiles |
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crimp2-mooring/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` | deployments indexed to H3 resolution 8 |

## Web map (MapLibre GL JS)

The PMTiles `source-layer` is **`crimp2-mooring`**.

```js
map.addSource('crimp2-mooring', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crimp2-mooring.pmtiles'
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'crimp2-mooring', type: 'circle', source: 'crimp2-mooring', 'source-layer': 'crimp2-mooring',
  paint: { 'circle-radius': 4, 'circle-color': '#1f78b4' }
});
```

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
-- Monthly mean sea surface temperature and seawater pCO2, good-quality records only
SELECT date_trunc('month', time) AS month, avg(sst) AS sst_c, avg(pco2_sw_sat) AS pco2_sw_uatm
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/crimp2-mooring/observations.parquet')
WHERE co2_sw_qf = 2
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
```

## cwb-beach-water-quality__README.md
# Hawaiʻi Beach Water Quality (Clean Water Branch, 1973–2024)

Shoreline water samples from the Hawaiʻi Department of Health Clean Water Branch, 1973–2024, at 473 locations in the main Hawaiian Islands: Enterococcus and Clostridium perfringens counts, with water temperature, salinity, turbidity, pH and dissolved oxygen on some samples. Several water-chemistry columns contain implausible values; see the column descriptions in the STAC collection before averaging them.

STAC collection: https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/cwb-beach-water-quality/stac-collection.json

## Files

| file | contents |
|---|---|
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/cwb-beach-water-quality/samples.parquet` | every sample, one row each (non-spatial) |
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/cwb-beach-water-quality.parquet` | sampling locations, one point each (GeoParquet) |
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/cwb-beach-water-quality.pmtiles` | sampling locations as vector tiles |
| `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/cwb-beach-water-quality/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` | sampling locations indexed to H3 resolution 8 |

## Web map (MapLibre GL JS)

The PMTiles `source-layer` is **`cwb-beach-water-quality`**.

```js
map.addSource('cwb-beach-water-quality', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/cwb-beach-water-quality.pmtiles'
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'cwb-beach-water-quality', type: 'circle', source: 'cwb-beach-water-quality', 'source-layer': 'cwb-beach-water-quality',
  paint: { 'circle-radius': 4, 'circle-color': '#1f78b4' }
});
```

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
-- Enterococcus samples per year at locations with 'KAILUA' in the name
SELECT year(s.time) AS yr, count(*) AS n, median(s.enterococcus) AS median_cfu
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/cwb-beach-water-quality/samples.parquet') s
JOIN read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/cwb-beach-water-quality.parquet') l USING (location_id)
WHERE l.location_name ILIKE '%kailua%' AND s.enterococcus IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
```

## hmrg-bathy-50m__README.md
# Main Hawaiian Islands Multibeam Bathymetry, 50 m (HMRG)

Seafloor depth around the Main Hawaiian Islands at 50 m resolution, from the Hawaii Mapping Research Group (HMRG) multibeam bathymetry synthesis, version 21 (University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, SOEST), as distributed by PacIOOS. Depth is in metres, negative below sea level. Land and areas without survey data are empty.

| Asset | Path |
|---|---|
| COG (0.0005°, ~50 m, EPSG:4326, Float32, nodata 0) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/hmrg-bathy-50m-cog.tif` |
| H3 hex, resolution 10 (mean depth per cell; parents 9, 8, 0) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/hmrg-bathy-50m/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |
| STAC | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/hmrg-bathy-50m/stac-collection.json` |

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;
-- mean depth in the H3 resolution 8 cell over Kāneʻohe Bay's patch reefs
SELECT AVG(depth_m) AS mean_depth_m
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/hmrg-bathy-50m/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
WHERE h8 = h3_latlng_to_cell(21.457, -157.808, 8);
```

Depth is a per-cell average: combine cells with an average, never a sum.

## MapLibre GL JS

The COG is a raster, so display it through a tile server such as TiTiler (there is no vector `source-layer`):

```js
map.addSource('hmrg-bathy', {
  type: 'raster',
  tiles: ['https://<titiler-host>/cog/tiles/WebMercatorQuad/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?url=https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/hmrg-bathy-50m-cog.tif&rescale=-6000,0&colormap_name=ocean'],
  tileSize: 256
});
map.addLayer({ id: 'hmrg-bathy', type: 'raster', source: 'hmrg-bathy' });
```

PacIOOS: "The data may be used and redistributed for free but is not intended for legal use, since it may contain inaccuracies." No warranty is given. Please acknowledge: "Data provided by PacIOOS (www.pacioos.org), which is a part of the U.S. Integrated Ocean Observing System (IOOS), funded in part by National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Award #NA21NOS0120091."

## ocean-tipping-points__README.md
# Ocean Tipping Points stressor rasters for the Main Hawaiian Islands

The 43 gridded layers of human and natural drivers on Hawaiian coral reefs that the Ocean Tipping Points project mapped for the coastal waters of the Main Hawaiian Islands (Wedding et al. 2018). They cover reef fish catch by sector and gear, sediment export, nearshore development, coastal habitat modification, cesspool and septic effluent and nutrient flux, invasive algae and fish, and long-term statistics of chlorophyll-a, light, sea surface temperature and wave power. Fishing, sediment and development layers are on a 100 m grid and hexed at H3 resolution 10; the rest are on a 500 m grid and hexed at resolution 9. Every layer carries h8 and h0, so layers can be joined to each other and to the rest of the catalog at resolution 8.

Each child collection has an H3 hexagon table and a Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF of the source grid. PacIOOS hosts the layers; they were requested through its GeoServer WCS at their native pixel size.

PacIOOS distributes the Ocean Tipping Points layers under these terms: the data may be used and redistributed for free but are not intended for legal use, since they may contain inaccuracies. Credit the Ocean Tipping Points project as a source, and cite Wedding et al. (2018), PLOS ONE 13(3): e0189792. The project also asks users to contact it before applying the data to project work, so that the principal investigator, Carrie Kappel at NCEAS (kappel@nceas.ucsb.edu), can track uses and avoid duplicated efforts.

## Layers

Each layer is published as a Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF on its native grid and as an H3 hexagon table.
The value column in each table has the layer's short name.

| Short name | Title | H3 resolution |
|---|---|---|
| `chlor_anom_freq` | Chlorophyll-a anomaly frequency in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `chlor_anom_max` | Chlorophyll-a maximum anomaly in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `chlor_avg` | Long-term mean chlorophyll-a in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `chlor_clim_max` | Chlorophyll-a maximum monthly climatology in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `chlor_std` | Chlorophyll-a variability in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `coastal_mod` | Coastal habitat modification in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `fishing` | Total reef fish catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_com` | Commercial reef fish catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_com_line` | Commercial line fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_com_net` | Commercial net fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_com_spear` | Commercial spear fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_rec` | Non-commercial reef fish catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_rec_boat` | Non-commercial boat-based fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_rec_boat_line` | Non-commercial boat-based line fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_rec_boat_net` | Non-commercial boat-based net fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_rec_boat_spear` | Non-commercial boat-based spear fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_rec_shore` | Non-commercial shore-based fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_rec_shore_line` | Non-commercial shore-based line fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_rec_shore_net` | Non-commercial shore-based net fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `fishing_rec_shore_spear` | Non-commercial shore-based spear fishing catch in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `invasive_algae` | Observed invasive algae in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `invasive_fish` | Observed invasive reef fish in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `nearshore_dev` | Nearshore new development impact in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `nearshore_sediment` | Sediment export to nearshore waters of the Main Hawaiian Islands | 10 |
| `osds_effluent` | Cesspool and septic effluent in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `osds_nitrogen` | Cesspool and septic nitrogen flux in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `osds_phosphorus` | Cesspool and septic phosphorus flux in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `par_anom_freq` | Light anomaly frequency in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `par_anom_max` | Light maximum anomaly in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `par_avg` | Long-term mean light in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `par_clim_max` | Light maximum monthly climatology in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `par_std` | Light variability in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `sst_anom_freq` | Sea surface temperature anomaly frequency in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |
| `sst_anom_max` | Sea surface temperature maximum anomaly in the Main Hawaiian Islands | 9 |

## Files

- `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/ocean-tipping-points/<short>-cog.tif` is the map image (WGS84, source pixel size and no-data value kept).
- `s3://public-hawaii/ocean-tipping-points/<short>/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` is the hexagon table, with columns for the value, the native H3 cell (`h9` or `h10`), `h8` and `h0`.
- `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/ocean-tipping-points/<short>/stac-collection.json` is each layer's STAC collection, with sources, terms and column descriptions.

## Query with DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET s3_endpoint = 's3-west.nrp-nautilus.io'; SET s3_url_style = 'path';

-- mean sea surface temperature in each resolution 8 cell around Oʻahu
SELECT h8, avg(sst_avg) AS sst_avg
FROM read_parquet('s3://public-hawaii/ocean-tipping-points/sst_avg/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
WHERE h3_cell_to_lat(h8) BETWEEN 21.2 AND 21.8
  AND h3_cell_to_lng(h8) BETWEEN -158.3 AND -157.6
GROUP BY h8;
```

## osds__README.md
# Onsite Sewage Disposal Systems (Hawaiʻi DOH, five islands)

Onsite sewage disposal systems (cesspools, septic tanks, aerobic units, soil treatment) on Oʻahu, Molokaʻi, Maui, Kauaʻi and Hawaiʻi Island, from the Hawaiʻi State Department of Health. Each of the 94,996 points is a tax map key parcel centroid carrying the number of systems on the parcel and their estimated effluent, nitrogen and phosphorus discharge. Oʻahu was surveyed in 2008, the other islands in 2010. Locations are approximate (one point per parcel).

## Files

| Asset | URL |
|---|---|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/osds.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/osds.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex (resolution 8, partitioned by h0) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/osds/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

## Two schemas in one table

The five island layers come in two schemas. Oʻahu fields (`ttl_osds`, `ttl_n`, `osds_class`, `rsk_score`, the per-class `soil_*`, `st_*`, `au_*`, `cp_*` fields) are null on the other islands; neighbour-island fields (`osds_qty`, `n_flux`, `class_i` to `class_iv`, tax and treatment-plant fields) are null on Oʻahu. `layer_island`, `county` and `survey_year` are filled on every row. `type` is a system type on Oʻahu and a treatment-plant marker elsewhere. Empty text is a single space; `class`, `prmt_no` and `prmt_id` use -9999 for rows with no treatment-plant record.

## DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
SELECT layer_island, COUNT(*) AS parcels,
       SUM(COALESCE(ttl_osds, osds_qty)) AS systems,
       SUM(COALESCE(ttl_n, n_flux)) AS nitrogen_kg_per_day
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-hawaii/osds.parquet')
GROUP BY layer_island ORDER BY systems DESC;
```
